summary: Directory lists a removed tower named Brookgreen in Georgetown County. No source ties it to Brookgreen Gardens or dates it; the state tower-system history is the only dated context.

facts.status_note: Listed as Removed in the Forest Lookouts directory. No source found gives a removal date, and none ties the tower to Brookgreen Gardens.

notes_for_editor: Name match only. The directory gives no address or history for the tower. Its coordinates (33.5237, -79.0968, from the tower record) are about 0.4 km from the Gardens' coordinates on Wikipedia; that distance is my own calculation and is not evidence of a link. The Wikipedia lede is tagged as needing citations. Not fetched: the Gardens' own site (brookgreen.org), a 1973 National Register nomination for the Gardens, and the USGS Brookgreen quadrangle (older editions may show a tower symbol). A Post and Courier search snippet mentioned a Sampit Lookout Tower in Georgetown County on a different map sheet; not checked. The Post and Courier article is undated in the copy I read.
